summary.denominator: All 162 held-out questions, including unsupported DSL forms.
summary.critical_limit: All program-execution statistics use GOLD FinQA programs (oracle inputs). None measure question-to-program generation, retrieved-cell selection, end-to-end QA accuracy or free-text faithfulness.
summary.annotation_limit: Program results, exe_ans and written answers can disagree. Numeric comparisons tolerate common percent scales and reasonable rounding; these are diagnostics, not adjudicated labels.
